title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ Monday, September 7, 2026

🌤️ Weather — Sunny and warm. ~83°F, high near 86°/low 57°, ~1% rain. Light layers; sunglasses over a jacket. Cooler, overcast day follows tomorrow.

🗞️ Headlines
• US envoys Witkoff & Kushner met Zelenskyy in Kyiv, a day after lengthy Putin talks in Moscow.
• Amazon Prime cargo plane overran a runway at Miami Int'l, crashing into ground vehicles.
• Philippines VP Sara Duterte posted bail over alleged threats against President Marcos Jr.
• NY Fashion Week in full swing across the city this week.

🚇 Getting around — Mostly normal. Later this week: G line skips 4 Av–9 St, 15 St–Prospect Park & Fort Hamilton Pkwy nightly (10:45pm–5am), Sept 8–11.

🎉 NYC today — Yankees host the Rockies, 7:05pm. House of Kong, immersive 25-years-of-Gorillaz at Brooklyn Navy Yard (10am–8:30pm).

💡 Nugget — Peak NY Fashion Week; expect pop-up parties and street-style crowds around the Garment District and Chelsea.
